Complexity attribution and provenance for work-attribute model routing. Add a task-only complexity_source (enum human|agent|derived) and complexity_ruleset_version (string) provenance pair mirroring the shipped size contract, plus the machinery that makes complexity trustworthy for routing: a fail-closed audit event before write, source-requires-ruleset provenance-completeness validation, transport-aware actor stamping (CLI=human, MCP=agent; reject explicit human over MCP), generic-create refusal of reserved complexity keys, whole-map preservation on generic custom_fields updates, SQLite projection of the provenance columns, provenance query filters, and a two-axis route-eligibility predicate that reports provenance-complete only when size + size_source + size_ruleset_version + complexity + complexity_source + complexity_ruleset_version are all present and valid (so autoharness can fail-safe-upward). Keep complexity strictly input attribution (predicted difficulty) and never overwrite it with observed cost/outcome. Preserve non-conflation of complexity and size (no derived scalar). No queue-order or priority effect; dependency and priority gates remain authoritative. Feature/shipment complexity aggregation is deferred to a computed-on-read distribution (no stored rollup). Historical backfill is opt-in and attributed (no bulk auto-stamp); existing 20 attributed + 63 null queued tasks read unchanged after the additive migration.

This satisfies the explicit external route-OUT that autoharness owes to backlogit in cost-per-unit-of-work-reduction.md section 5.2 (backlogit owns field definition/storage/validation; autoharness owns application) and unblocks its P-013.7 downward-routing precondition (section 6.1) and two-axis routing table (section 6.2). Aligns with autoharness docs/design-docs/cost-per-unit-of-work-reduction.md (created 2026-09-10).

Design doc (authoritative why/how, work units, phases, acceptance criteria, open questions): docs/design-docs/2026-09-10-complexity-attribution-provenance.md

Recommended phasing: Phase 1 storage+validation+audit (the route-OUT) is independently shippable and unblocks autoharness; Phase 2 query + route-eligibility predicate; Phase 3 Stage/harvest stamping + backfill; Phase 4 deferred aggregation. Stage owns decomposition, sizing, and sequencing at curation time.
